bias_targets.methodology: Factorial demographic-pair comparisons across system prompts and counterfactual demographic-attribute probes to measure shifts in decision rates for high-stakes scenarios (e.g., loan approvals, housing eligibility) and intersectional sycophancy.

Matched-guise dialect probes comparing responses to inputs containing African-American English (AAE) or other dialect markers versus explicit identity declarations, measuring discrepancies in assigned job prestige, conviction rates, and safety filter refusal rates.

Audit-prompt versus user-persona-conditional response comparisons to detect asymmetric political stance shifts (e.g., rightward vs. leftward), as well as evaluating political censorship and semantic suppression on sensitive prompts.
